plan.title: Content ki length aur depth ko barhain
plan.detail: Muqabla karne wali sites par average 2284 alfaz hain jabke aap ke paas sirf 331 hain. Relevant keywords aur detail information ke sath content ko kam se kam 1500-2000 words tak barhain taake search engine aap ke page ko authoritative samjhe.

plan.title: High-quality images aur Alt Text shamil karein
plan.detail: Competitor sites par average 76 images hain jabke aap ki site par ek bhi image nahi hai. Topic se related images, diagrams aur infographics add karein aur un mein proper descriptive Alt text zaroor istemal karein.

plan.title: Internal linking network ko mazboot banayein
plan.detail: Aap ki site par sirf 5 internal links hain jabke competitors ke paas 153 hain. Apne doosre relevant pages, categories aur blog posts ko aapas mein link karein taake link juice flow ho aur user retention barhe.

plan.title: Content structure aur H2 Headings ko optimize karein
plan.detail: Competitors average 10 H2 headings use kar rahe hain jabke aap ke paas 5 hain. Apne content ko mazeed sub-topics mein takseem karein aur H2/H3 tags mein LSI (Latent Semantic Indexing) keywords shamil karein.

plan.title: Title Tag aur Meta Description ko compelling banayein
plan.detail: Naye content aur headings ke mutabiq catchy Click-Through Rate (CTR) oriented Meta Title aur Description likhein jin mein primary keywords aur Call to Action (CTA) shamil ho.

plan.title: Mobile Speed aur Core Web Vitals ko maintain rakhein
plan.detail: Aap ka speed score (99) aur LCP (0.8s) behtareen hai. Nayi images aur content add karte waqt Next-Gen formats (WebP) aur lazy loading ka istemal karein taake performance drop na ho.
